<!--
Thank you for sharing an idea.

Suggestions are always welcome. Please keep in mind that projects are developed in my free time, so a requested feature may not always be possible or may take time to implement.
-->

## 💡 Feature Request

<!--
Briefly describe the feature or improvement you would like to see.
-->



## 🎯 What Problem Would It Solve?

<!--
Explain why this feature would be useful.

If it solves a specific problem or limitation, describe that here.
-->



## ✨ Proposed Solution

<!--
Describe how you imagine the feature working.

You do not need to provide a technical implementation.
-->



## 🔄 Alternatives

<!--
Are there other ways this could be handled?
Leave blank if none.
-->



## 📸 Examples / Mockups

<!--
Optional: Add screenshots, drawings, examples from other apps, or mockups that help explain the idea.
-->



## 📝 Additional Context

<!--
Anything else that may help explain the suggestion.
-->



## ✔ Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues and did not find the same request.
- [ ] This request relates to the purpose of the project.
- [ ] I have explained what the feature would improve or solve.
